tests.name: cd With No Argument
tests.description: Uses 'cd' with no argument, which should change to the HOME directory.

tests.name: Append to Existing File
tests.description: Uses '>>' to append output to a file that already exists.

tests.name: Append Creates File
tests.description: Uses '>>' on a file that does not exist yet; it should be created.

tests.name: Append vs Truncate
tests.description: Verifies '>>' preserves existing content while '>' overwrites it.

tests.name: Mixed Redirected and Plain Commands
tests.description: Runs a sequence mixing redirected and non-redirected commands.

tests.name: Errors Do Not Kill the Shell
tests.description: Several failing commands in a row; the shell must keep prompting.

tests.name: Background Job with Output Redirection
tests.description: Runs a background job whose stdout is redirected to a file.

tests.name: Background Job with Input Redirection
tests.description: Runs a background job with both input and output redirected.

tests.name: fg on a Running Background Job
tests.description: Uses 'fg' to bring a background (not stopped) job into the foreground.

tests.name: Background Job Alongside Stopped Job
tests.description: Mixes a background job and a suspended foreground job.

tests.name: Suspend, bg, then wait-all
tests.description: Suspends a job, resumes it in the background, then waits for it.

tests.name: wait-all Skips Stopped Jobs
tests.description: 'wait-all' must ignore stopped jobs and leave them in the list.

tests.name: Repeated Interrupt and Suspend
tests.description: Interrupts and suspends several programs in sequence.

tests.name: Malformed Job Command Arguments
tests.description: Job commands with missing or invalid index arguments.

tests.name: Multiple Background Jobs Waited Individually
tests.description: Two background jobs awaited one at a time with 'wait-for'.

tests.name: Directory Navigation Sequence
tests.description: Relative and absolute 'cd' calls interleaved with programs.

tests.name: Full Session Combining All Features
tests.description: One long session: cd, redirection of all three kinds, a background job, a suspended job, wait-for, fg, and wait-all.
